notes: GAAP city. Governmental receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (pp6-7). Loan/bond proceeds 4,845,000 printed inside Total revenues 23,598,262 are recorded in debt_proceeds (reported_totals includes debt_proceeds); receipts list excludes it. Roll-forward: 19,139,171 + 18,753,262 - 24,147,114 + 4,845,000 = 18,590,319. Transfers in/out 3,076,422 each. ending_cash = Cash and cash equivalents on governmental funds Balance Sheet total (6,040,239, p5); certificates of deposit 12,384,934 (recorded as ending_investments, informational) and county treasurer cash 113,132 are separate lines there. Business-type: Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, Total Enterprise Funds (p9) (Water, Sewer, Landfill); internal service fund column (health insurance) not included. Business-type receipts = operating revenues 8,483,334 + nonoperating interest, grant income and gain on sale (computed, no single printed total); disbursements = total operating expenses 6,458,921 + interest expense 392,667 + bond fees 147,543 = 6,999,131 printed as total business-type expenses on Statement of Activities (p2). Net position change 2,723,259 ties. Business-type expense categories are all 'utilities' by function (object-level lines). Proprietary cash flows: Total column (p11) of the Statement of Cash Flows, enterprise funds. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position Total primary government column (p1); due from/to other funds nets to zero and is omitted. Detail: budget schedules (cash basis, pp15-19) for Street, CDBG, Debt Service, LB 357, Capital Projects (amounts differ slightly from GAAP statement); nonmajor combining Total column (p21) because 7 nonmajor funds. General Fund detail comes from the Combining Statement of Revenues and Expenditures - Modified Accrual Basis - General Fund Departments (p22 General, Capital Projects, Auditorium, Parks, Police, Community Center columns; p23, added by the v8 re-trim, Aquatic Center through Police & Fire Pension and Total columns), one line per department per object line; totals revenues 18,925,192 (includes loan/bond proceeds 4,845,000, recorded as other financing, printed_in revenue) and expenditures 18,147,396 tie to the Total column; transfers (to) from other funds per department (net -65,891) are printed below the excess line (outside_printed_total). It replaces the cash-basis General Fund budget schedule (p14: total resources 19,031,767, charges to appropriations 18,000,378, budget 20,199,858 / 22,035,481) to avoid double counting, so General Fund budget_final is null. 'Salaries and benefits' (mixed) recorded as salaries and wages (dominant); the Police & Fire Pension column as benefits. Capital outlay, principal, interest and bond fees lines take the capital outlay/debt service functions as on the statement; other lines take the department's function (Auditorium, Parks, Community/Aquatic/Senior/Convention Center, Ball Park, Library, Museum, Soccer Complex: culture/recreation, the city's environment and leisure). The departments schedule's Capital Projects column is a General Fund department, distinct from the Capital Projects Fund budget schedule (p19). Debt Service budget schedule prints no revenue total. Capital projects budget schedule has capital outlay '-' actual (budget 2,089,683) so no expenditure line. Read pages 1-23 of 23.
